import sys
import struct

from pwn import *

class SPUEmulator:
    def __init__(self, code_data):
        self.code = code_data
        self.registers = [0] * 128  # SPU has 128 registers
        self.pc = 0x30  # Start execution at offset 0x30 (after header)
        self.ls = bytearray(0x40000)  # 256KB Local Store memory
        
        # Copy code into local store
        for i in range(min(len(self.code), len(self.ls))):
            self.ls[i] = self.code[i]
        
        # Input buffer in local store
        self.input_buffer = 0x1000  # Arbitrary buffer location
        
    def get_word(self, addr):
        """Get a word (4 bytes) from local store memory"""
        return struct.unpack(">I", self.ls[addr:addr+4])[0]
    
    def set_word(self, addr, value):
        """Set a word (4 bytes) in local store memory"""
        self.ls[addr:addr+4] = struct.pack(">I", value)
    
    def set_input(self, input_data):
        """Set input in the designated buffer"""
        for i, b in enumerate(input_data):
            self.ls[self.input_buffer + i] = b
        # Null terminate
        self.ls[self.input_buffer + len(input_data)] = 0
        
    def decode_instruction(self, instr):
        """Decode an SPU instruction (very simplified)"""
        opcode = (instr >> 24) & 0xFF
        a = (instr >> 16) & 0xFF
        b = (instr >> 8) & 0xFF
        c = instr & 0xFF
        
        # High-level description of what the instruction might do
        desc = "Unknown instruction"
        
        if opcode == 0x00:
            desc = "NOP or Header field"
        elif opcode == 0x10:
            desc = f"Potential branch to 0x{a<<16 | b<<8 | c:x}"

        return {
            "opcode": opcode,
            "a": a,
            "b": b,
            "c": c,
            "description": desc
        }
    
    def execute_step(self):
        """Execute a single SPU instruction"""
        if self.pc + 4 > len(self.ls):
            return False, "PC out of bounds"
        
        instr = self.get_word(self.pc)
        decoded = self.decode_instruction(instr)

        b = decoded["b"]
